description: Run inference on a Workers AI model. The request body is model-specific: fetch the model's input schema with `cf ai get-model-schema --model <id>` (or `cf ai run <model> --help`) to discover its fields, then pass them as flags or as a single JSON payload via --body. `cf ai models list` enumerates the models this account can run.

options.name: body
options.description: Raw JSON request body, or @path to a JSON file. Use instead of the model's input flags.

options.name: dry-run
options.description: Validate and show what would happen without executing

options.name: help
options.description: Show help, including this model's input flags
